investment_theses.thesis: Long crude oil (WTI) via futures/ETF; short BTC or hedge BTC long with OIL short, as Strait of Hormuz geopolitical premium overcomes macro headwinds through Q3 2026.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Container ship sinks in Strait of Hormuz; Iran escalating strikes to choke off crude rebound
Cointelegraph: Bitcoin price dips below $82K as high oil prices spike US CPI inflation
Geopolitical risk premium is nascent; markets pricing in only ~$5-10/bbl of Iran premium currently
investment_theses.counter_view: Global recession fears (BlackRock data center warning, elevated rates, Netflix layoffs) could collapse demand for crude and risk assets simultaneously; if recession prices in faster than geopolitical escalation, OIL falls despite supply shock.

investment_theses.thesis: Short U.S. Treasury yields (long TLT, long ZB futures) into end-Q2 2026 as recession risk priced in faster than Fed cuts, triggering safe-haven bid.

Netflix/corporate layoff wave is leading indicator; credit spreads haven't widened yet
investment_theses.counter_view: Fed stays resolute on inflation fight; if labor market holds up and wage growth doesn't crack, yields stay elevated as Fed keeps powder dry; recent rate forecast revisions could anchor yields higher, not lower.
investment_theses.expression: Long TLT (20+ yr Treasury ETF) or long 10Y/30Y bullet on the long end; short SPY or long SPY puts to hedge equity downside if yields rally
